data.name: Murtadha
data.gender_notes: Murtadha is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Murtadha is an Arabic name that means 'chosen or accepted by Allah'. It is a name that signifies divine approval and blessings. The name Murtadha carries the meaning “Chosen or Accepted” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Murtadha usually hope their child will grow to embody chosen or accepted and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Murtadha is considered a sacred name, implying that the person is chosen by Allah for a higher purpose.
data.etymology: Murtadha belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Chosen or Accepted.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Murtadha total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
